description: Procedures for labelling information according to the classification scheme are not implemented.
applicability: Applies when an organization has a classification scheme but lacks procedures for labelling information assets, or when information is classified but labels are not consistently applied to documents, files, emails, and other information containers.

metadata.detection_notes: Review labelling procedures, assess whether documents and emails include classification labels, verify metadata tagging in information systems, check for automated labelling tools, evaluate user compliance with labelling requirements.
